decision_needed.question: Governmental funds show net transfers in of 277,724 while business-type activities show transfers out of 287,724 (difference 10,000 goes to the component unit CRA). Should the governmental transfer be recorded as net 277,724 as printed?

'Nolde Trust support' 141,400 is recorded as revenue. If it comes from the city's own Nolde Trust Fund it is an interfund transfer and is counted twice (revenue here, spending there). Should it be moved to transfers?

ending_cash holds total fund balances 3,309,399 (the modified-cash roll-forward, p5), not printed total cash 3,311,135 (p4; payroll withholdings payable 1,736 deducted). Should ending_cash be the printed cash with the 1,736 liability as an adjustment (beginning liability not shown)?

notes: Primary government uses modified cash basis for governmental activities and accrual for business-type activities; basis recorded as cash. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Bond proceeds 5,250,000 are inside printed total revenues 8,278,172 and are recorded in debt_proceeds, not receipts; transfers 277,724 is printed net ('Transfers in (out)') in Other financing uses. Roll-forward: 3,613,206 + 3,028,172 - 8,859,703 + 277,724 + 5,250,000 = 3,309,399 (total fund balances; cash 3,258,122 + county treasurer 53,013 less payroll withholdings payable 1,736 per p4). Intergovernmental 327,570 split into highway allocation 280,349, motor vehicle fees 18,647 (Street Fund p12) and General Fund 28,574. Business-type: the trimmed PDF lacks the page with Sewer, Trash and Total columns of the proprietary statements (p8 and p9 show only Light and Water). Light and Water lines are itemized from p8; Sewer and Trash revenue/expenses and the interest/insurance totals come from the Statement of Activities (p2-3); totals tie to total business-type expenses 2,404,160 and charges 2,518,157. Business-type roll-forward from net position: 7,947,451 + 2,698,032 - 2,404,160 - 287,724 = 7,953,599. Proprietary cash flow block left null (cash flow statement shows only Light and Water). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total primary government column (p1; component unit excluded); the unrestricted 4,979,603 combines governmental 577,154 and business-type 4,402,449 as printed in total. Detail: General Fund budget schedule shows department-level actual (public safety 335,169; environment and leisure 499,343) which differs from statement function totals because of capital outlay reclassification; no business-type budget schedules in trimmed PDF. Component unit (CRA) ignored. Read pages 1-17 of 17 v8 re-trim added report p23 (trimmed p10, Light/Water cash flow reconciliation); nothing new added, later pages renumbered.
